app.tagline: One wallet that grows with you.
app.crashBody: This view could not be displayed. Your wallet and your balance are not affected.
app.loadFailed: The data could not be loaded.
app.loadFailedBody: Check your internet connection. We keep trying in the background.
app.statusFailed: The state of your wallet cannot be queried right now.
app.statusFailedBody: Your existing wallet stays untouched — we will not set up anything new while this is unclear.
onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome
onboarding.welcome.body: Set up your wallet in a few steps. Everything stays on this device — we have no access to it.
onboarding.welcome.notAudited: Note: this software is not audited and starts on the test network.
onboarding.password.title: Choose a password
onboarding.password.body: You unlock the wallet on this device with this password. We cannot reset it for you.
onboarding.password.label: Password
onboarding.password.tooWeak: Please choose a stronger password — it protects your recovery phrase on this device.
onboarding.phrase.title: Your recovery phrase
onboarding.phrase.body: Write these words down in order and keep them safe. Anyone who knows them can spend your balance.
onboarding.phrase.hidden: Tap to reveal — make sure nobody is looking over your shoulder.
onboarding.phrase.written: I have written the words down
onboarding.phrase.neverShare: Never share your recovery phrase. No support agent will ever ask for it.
onboarding.verify.title: Quick check
onboarding.verify.body: Tap word {p1}, word {p2} and word {p3} in this order.
onboarding.verify.wrong: That was not the right word. Please try again.
onboarding.done.title: Your wallet is ready
onboarding.done.body: Recovery phrase confirmed, password set. You have finished the two most important steps.
onboarding.import.title: Restore wallet
onboarding.import.body: Enter your recovery phrase — 12 or 24 words, separated by spaces.
onboarding.import.invalid: This recovery phrase is not valid. Please check the spelling and the order.
unlock.title: Unlock wallet
unlock.forgotBody: Without the password you can only reset the wallet and set it up again with your recovery phrase.
unlock.resetConfirm: Really reset? All data on this device will be deleted. Without your recovery phrase your balance will be unreachable.
unlock.throttledBody: To protect your wallet, unlocking is paused for a moment. Just try again afterwards.
home.reservedExplain: A small part of your balance is reserved for your account and cannot be sent.
home.notFunded: This account does not exist on the network yet.
home.fundFailed: The test balance could not be requested.
checklist.title: Secure your wallet
checklist.remainingOne: 1 step left to a safe start
checklist.remainingMany: {count} steps left to a safe start
send.title: Send
send.insufficient: Your available balance is not enough.
send.memoTooLong: This reference is too long ({bytes} of 28 bytes). Special characters count as multiple bytes.
confirm.title: Please confirm
confirm.blocked: This transaction cannot be confirmed because we do not fully understand it.
receive.title: Receive
receive.body: Scan the code or copy your address.
receive.warning: This is a test network address. Do not send real balance to it.
receive.onlyStellar: Only send Stellar assets (XLM and tokens) to this address.
history.title: Activity
history.emptyBody: As soon as you send or receive something, it will show up here.
settings.title: Settings
settings.mode.beginnerBody: Plain language, no technical views, test network by default.
settings.mode.developerBody: Adds the technical transaction view, network selection, manual fee and connections to applications in your browser.
settings.mode.warnBody: In developer mode, websites can ask your wallet for confirmations and technical views are shown. Only turn it on if you know what you are doing.
settings.network.mainnetWarn: The main network involves real balances.
settings.network.gateBody: On the main network you move real money. Payments are final and nobody can reverse them — we cannot either. This wallet has not been externally audited. Start with a small amount.
settings.recoveryBody: Your password is required to confirm.
settings.notAudited: This software is not audited. No investment advice, no promised returns.
dapp.title: Request from a website
dapp.signBody: {origin} asks you to confirm a transaction.
dapp.unknownOrigin: You have not used this website before.
dapp.signingAsOther: Caution: the website requests the signature from a different account than the one you are currently using.
tx.summary.feeBump: Fee increase for an existing transaction
tx.summary.unparseable: This transaction could not be read.
tx.op.createAccount: Create the new account {destination} with {amount} XLM
tx.op.changeTrust.pool: Change the asset approval for a liquidity pool (limit {limit})
tx.op.accountMerge: Close the account and transfer the entire balance to {destination}
tx.op.manageSellOffer: Offer {amount} {selling} for {buying} at a price of {price}
tx.op.manageBuyOffer: Buy {amount} {buying} for {selling} at a price of {price}
tx.op.createClaimableBalance: Make {amount} {asset} available for {claimants} recipients to claim
tx.op.liquidityPoolDeposit: Deposit up to {maxAmountA} and {maxAmountB} into a liquidity pool
tx.op.inflation: Trigger inflation (no longer supported by the network)
tx.warn.SIGNER_OR_THRESHOLD_CHANGE: This transaction changes who may control your account. Only confirm it if you started it yourself.
tx.warn.TRUSTLINE_REMOVAL: The asset approval for {asset} will be removed. This only works if your balance of that asset is zero.
tx.warn.ACCOUNT_MERGE: Your account will be closed. The entire balance goes to {destination} and the address will be empty afterwards.
tx.warn.HIGH_SLIPPAGE: The rate may differ by up to {percent} % (limit {threshold} %).
tx.warn.SLIPPAGE_UNKNOWN: We could not check the possible rate deviation.
tx.warn.UNKNOWN_ISSUER: {code} comes from an issuer ({issuer}) you have not used so far. Assets can name themselves freely.
tx.warn.DESTINATION_NOT_FUNDED: The account {destination} does not exist on the network yet. This payment creates it, and part of the amount then stays locked as a reserved account balance for as long as the account exists.
tx.warn.SEQUENCE_GAP: The sequence number jumps (expected {expected}, found {actual}). The transaction may come from a different context.
tx.warn.UNTRANSLATABLE_OPERATION: We cannot translate this operation into plain language ({type}). Do not confirm it if you are not expecting it.
tx.warn.UNPARSEABLE_TRANSACTION: This transaction could not be read. For safety we do not confirm anything we do not understand.
tx.warn.NETWORK_MISMATCH: The transaction belongs to a different network than the one you selected ({expected}).
tx.warn.FOREIGN_SOURCE_ACCOUNT: The sender is {source}, not your selected account.
tx.warn.SOROBAN_INVOCATION: This transaction calls a smart contract. What exactly happens depends on the contract's code.
tx.warn.MAINNET_REAL_FUNDS: You are on the main network. Real balances are at stake here.
tx.warn.MEMO_REQUIRED: The recipient {destination} requires a memo, but this transaction has none. Payments without a memo can be lost at the recipient (e.g. an exchange).
soroban.blocked.title: Smart contracts are disabled in beginner mode
soroban.blocked.body: Smart contract calls cannot be translated into plain language. You can enable them in developer mode.
error.WALLET_LOCKED: The wallet is locked. Please unlock it.
error.WALLET_EXISTS: A wallet is already set up on this device.
error.NO_WALLET: No wallet has been set up on this device yet.
error.WEAK_PASSWORD: That password is too easy to guess. Choose a longer or less predictable one.
error.UNLOCK_THROTTLED: Too many failed attempts. Please wait {seconds} seconds and try again.
error.MEMO_REQUIRED: This recipient address requires a memo (common for exchanges). Please enter the memo from your deposit instructions — without it the payment can be lost.
error.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many open requests from this page. Answer the pending confirmations first.
error.NETWORK_ERROR: The network cannot be reached right now.
error.TIMEOUT: That took too long. Please try again.
error.INVALID_MNEMONIC: This recovery phrase is not valid.
error.INVALID_MEMO: The reference (memo) is too long: it may be at most 28 bytes. Special characters and emoji count as multiple bytes.
error.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: This account does not exist on the network.
error.DEVELOPER_MODE_REQUIRED: Developer mode must be switched on for this.
error.UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION: This action is not supported yet.
error.txcode.tx_failed: One step of this transaction failed, so the whole transaction was discarded. Nothing was sent.
error.txcode.tx_bad_seq: This transaction collided with another one from your account. Nothing was sent — just try again.
error.txcode.tx_too_late: The transaction stayed open too long and expired. Nothing was sent — simply set it up again.
error.txcode.tx_too_early: The transaction was not valid yet when it reached the network. Check that your device's clock is right, then try again.
error.txcode.tx_insufficient_fee: The network fee was too low, the network was busy at that moment. Nothing was sent — trying again in a few minutes usually works.
error.txcode.tx_insufficient_balance: Your XLM balance does not even cover the network fee without dipping into your reserved account balance. Top up a little XLM.
error.txcode.tx_no_source_account: Your account does not exist on the network yet. It has to be activated with a little XLM first.
error.txcode.tx_bad_auth: The signature did not match. Nothing was sent — check in Settings whether the right network is selected.
error.txcode.tx_bad_auth_extra: The transaction carried signatures that do not belong to it. Nothing was sent.
error.txcode.tx_missing_operation: The transaction contained no instruction at all. Nothing was sent — please set it up again.
error.txcode.tx_malformed: The transaction was put together incorrectly and was rejected. Nothing was sent.
error.txcode.tx_not_supported: The network does not accept this kind of transaction at the moment. Nothing was sent.
error.txcode.tx_internal_error: Something went wrong inside the network while processing this. Nothing was sent — try again in a moment.
error.txcode.tx_soroban_invalid: The smart contract part of this transaction was no longer valid. Nothing was swapped — fetch a fresh quote and try again.
error.txcode.op_malformed: The instruction was faulty — most likely something about the address, the amount or the asset is off. Nothing was sent.
error.txcode.op_too_many_subentries: Your account has reached the maximum number of entries. Remove an asset approval you no longer need before adding a new one.
error.txcode.op_exceeded_work_limit: The instruction was too much work for the network. Try a smaller amount — nothing was sent.
error.txcode.op_underfunded: Your balance is not enough for this. Keep in mind that part of your XLM is tied up as a reserved account balance and cannot be spent.
error.txcode.op_low_reserve: Your account is a little short on XLM for this step: every extra entry requires a small reserve. Top up some XLM and try again.
error.txcode.op_already_exists: The recipient's account exists by now after all. Just send the payment again — it will go out as an ordinary transfer.
error.txcode.op_no_destination: The recipient's account does not exist on the network yet. A new account has to be activated with XLM first — and it is worth checking the address again.
error.txcode.op_no_trust: The recipient cannot accept this asset yet. They have to approve it in their own wallet first — nothing was sent.
error.txcode.op_not_authorized: The issuer of this asset has not cleared the recipient to hold it. Only the issuer can change that — nothing was sent.
error.txcode.op_line_full: The recipient cannot take in this amount: the limit they set for this asset is used up. There is nothing wrong with your wallet, and nothing was sent.
error.txcode.op_no_issuer: The issuer of this asset does not exist on the network. Check the issuer address again — nothing was sent.
error.txcode.op_src_no_trust: You have not approved this asset in your wallet yet, so you cannot send it. Add it first.
error.txcode.op_src_not_authorized: The issuer of this asset has not cleared your account to send it. Only the issuer can change that.
error.txcode.op_too_few_offers: There is no trading route between these two assets right now. Try a smaller amount or come back later — nothing was swapped.
error.txcode.op_cross_self: The swap would have traded against one of your own open offers. Nothing was swapped.
error.txcode.op_under_dest_min: The rate moved while you were confirming: you would have received less than promised. So nothing was swapped — fetch a fresh quote.
error.txcode.op_invalid_limit: The limit is below what you already hold of this asset. Pick a higher limit, or move your balance elsewhere first.
error.txcode.op_self_not_allowed: You cannot approve an asset whose issuer is your own account.
error.txcode.op_cannot_delete: This asset approval cannot be removed because the asset is still tied up in a pool on your account. Release that share first.
error.txcode.op_not_aut_maintain_liabili: The issuer of this asset has blocked your account for it, so the approval cannot be changed right now. Only the issuer can lift that.
error.txcode.function_trapped: The smart contract behind this swap aborted. Nothing was swapped — fetch a fresh quote and try again.
error.txcode.resource_limit_exceeded: The operation needed more computing power than the network allows. Nothing was swapped — a smaller amount often does the trick.
error.txcode.entry_archived: Data this swap needs is archived on the network and would have to be restored first. Nothing was swapped.
error.txcode.insufficient_refundable_fee: The fee set aside was not enough for this smart contract call. Nothing was swapped — fetch a fresh quote and try again.
asset.addBody: An asset approval tells the network that you are willing to receive this asset. Only then can someone send it to you.
asset.reserveHint: Each approved asset reserves a small amount of your balance (0.5 XLM). You get it back when you remove the approval.
asset.curatedNote: This short list is fixed inside the extension. Which assets belong on it, and who decides, is still an open question.
asset.curatedNone: There is no vetted list for this network. Assets can only be added by issuer address here (developer mode).
asset.codeInvalid: An asset code has 1 to 12 letters or digits.
asset.limitHint: Highest amount you want to hold. Empty means no limit; 0 removes the approval.
asset.limitZero: A limit of 0 removes this asset approval. That only works when your balance of it is exactly 0.
settings.accountAddBody: A new account is derived from your recovery phrase. Your password is needed so it can be stored securely — otherwise it would be gone the next time the wallet locks.
settings.permission.networkDenied: Without access to that network's endpoints the wallet cannot switch to it. The network stays unchanged.
settings.permission.dappDenied: Developer mode is on, but without access to websites the connector for web applications stays off. You can grant it later in your browser's extension settings.
onboarding.import.passphraseHint: Only if you set one when the wallet was created. A wrong entry silently leads to a different, empty wallet.
error.SOROBAN_SIMULATION_FAILED: The smart contract call could not be simulated and was therefore not signed.
error.PERMISSION_REQUIRED: The wallet is missing a browser permission for this.
tx.warn.DESTINATION_NOT_FUNDED.unreachab: The account {destination} does not exist on the network yet. This payment will not reach it — the account has to be created first.
home.buySoon: Buying XLM right in the wallet (through regulated anchor partners) is coming soon.
swap.title: Swap
swap.noPath: There is currently no trading route for this pair on the network. Try a smaller amount or a different asset.
swap.amountTooSmall: This amount is too small: after the maximum price movement nothing would be left. Try a larger amount.
swap.successBody: Your swap was accepted by the network.
swap.needTwoAssets: A swap needs at least two approved assets. Add an asset first.
swap.slippageHint: If the rate moves against you by more than this while the swap runs, the network cancels it automatically — you lose nothing.
error.QUOTE_EXPIRED: The quote has expired in the meantime. Please fetch a fresh one.
error.SWAP_ENVELOPE_MISMATCH: The swap the exchange service returned does not match the quote you were shown. Nothing was signed.
error.KEYSTORE_UNREADABLE: Your wallet data could not be read. Do NOT create a new wallet — that would overwrite it. Restore from your recovery phrase or use the extension version you had before.
settings.rpc.body: By default the wallet tries several public Soroban endpoints in order. Add your own here and it is tried first; the public ones stay as a fallback.
settings.rpc.label: Endpoint URL (stored on this device only)
settings.rpc.cspNote: If the URL contains an access key it stays on this device and is never synced to your other profiles. For technical reasons only providers already enabled in this version can be used (currently Alchemy plus the public endpoints).
settings.rpc.saved: Endpoint saved. It will be tried first from now on.
settings.rpc.errorUrl: That is not a valid URL.
settings.rpc.errorHttps: Only https is allowed. Over http an access key in the address would travel unencrypted.
settings.rpc.errorHost: This provider is not enabled in this version. The extension may only talk to addresses fixed when the package was built — that cannot be changed afterwards. Use one of the supported providers, or ask for yours to be added.
settings.rpc.errorPermission: Without permission to access this address the wallet cannot use the endpoint. It was not saved.
submit.unknown.title: Outcome still open
submit.unknown.headline: Do not send this again.
submit.unknown.body: Your transaction is on its way and we do not know yet whether it arrived — do not send it a second time, or you may end up paying twice.
submit.unknown.checking: We ask the network about this id every few seconds. Leave this window open and the result appears here as soon as it is settled — after three minutes at the latest.
submit.unknown.ifYouClose: You can close this window. Until the outcome is settled the wallet will not build a second transaction for this account; afterwards your history shows what happened.
submit.unknown.expired: This transaction has expired — it can no longer reach the network. Nothing was sent. You can try again.
submit.unknown.rejected: The network picked the transaction up and rejected it. Nothing was sent. You can try again.
error.SUBMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Your previous transaction is still on its way and its outcome is open. Until that is settled the wallet will not build a second one — please wait a moment instead of sending again.
confirm.feeMaxHint: Stellar charges every transaction in a ledger the same market price. The amount shown is the most you bid for it — you normally pay less.
send.maxHint: “Max” keeps {amount} XLM back for the network fee.
tx.warn.HIGH_FEE: The fee limit on this transaction is unusually high: {feeXlm} XLM, {factor} times the usual amount. Please check it before you confirm.
tx.warn.SOROBAN_AUTH_FOREIGN_CONTRACT: Signing this also authorises calls to {count} further contract(s): {contracts}. Those calls are part of the same signature, even though the transaction does not name them in its summary.
tx.warn.SOROBAN_AUTH_THIRD_PARTY: Part of this call is authorised by another address ({addresses}), not by you.
tx.warn.SOROBAN_PARTIAL_DECODE: Not every part of this contract call could be decoded. What is shown below is incomplete.
confirm.contractCallHint: Read from the transaction itself. The wallet does not fetch a contract description from anywhere; function and argument names are what the contract's caller wrote, not a claim by us about what they do.
passkey.title: Passkey unlock
passkey.body: Unlock with your fingerprint, face or security key instead of typing the password. Your password keeps working and stays the way in if the passkey is ever unavailable.
passkey.enableWarn: Your password is needed once. Adding a second key to a wallet is something only the holder of the first one may do.
passkey.enabled: A passkey is set up on this installation.
passkey.unsupported: This browser or device offers no passkey that can produce key material, so there is nothing here that could protect your wallet.
passkey.error.unsupported: This browser or device cannot do it.
passkey.error.noPrf: This passkey cannot derive key material (the PRF extension is missing), so it cannot unlock a wallet. Nothing was stored.
passkey.error.permissionDenied: Without the permission for aubergine.tech no passkey can be created; that domain is the name your passkey is filed under.
passkey.error.popupClosed: The window closed during the request. Please open the wallet in a tab and try again.
error.PASSKEY_FAILED: This passkey does not open this wallet. Please use your password.
error.PASSKEY_NOT_ENROLLED: No passkey is set up on this installation.
